popup.title: Expert Update
popup.message: 4 new Expert stages with 40 Korean homophones. Now 10 stages and 100 words in total!

notices.title: Expert Stages Expanded
notices.message: 4 new Expert stages added. Expert now has 10 stages with 100 Korean homophones (10 questions each). Practice tricky words like "산" (mountain / acid / coral), "화" (fire / flower / speech / anger), and "사" (four / death / affair / company).

notices.title: Intermediate Stages Expanded
notices.message: 4 new Intermediate stages added. Intermediate now has 11 stages with 110 adjectives and emotions (10 questions each). Practice words like "차분하다", "뿌듯하다", and "믿음직하다".

notices.title: Advanced Stages Expanded
notices.message: 2 new Advanced stages added. Advanced now has 9 stages with 90 Korean proverbs (10 questions each). Practice everyday idioms like "누워서 침 먹기" and "백문이 불여일견".

notices.title: Beginner Stages Expanded
notices.message: 4 more Beginner stages added. Beginner now has 17 stages with 170 words (10 questions each). Also fixed minor typo issues.

notices.title: New Stages Added
notices.message: 2 new stages in every level: Beginner 9, Intermediate 7, Advanced 7, and Expert 6 stages (10 questions each). 80 new words and proverbs in total.

notices.title: App Improvements
notices.message: Web content now updates automatically without clearing cache. The back button exits the app from Home, and goes back inside quizzes and settings.

notices.title: New Daily 3
notices.message: Start a quick 3-question session and keep your streak alive.

notices.title: Review Mode Added
notices.message: Wrong answers are now saved automatically so you can review them later.
